name: loading-carousel

frames.best_why: A single slide is fully at rest with its photo, caption and progress row all visible.

tagline: A photo carousel with captions and segmented progress underneath.
summary: A wide image carousel that autoplays through tips, each with a photo, a caption line and a row of thin progress segments you can click.
appearance: A wide rounded image fills the top of a dark card, with a slim caption row below it. At the bottom, five hairline progress segments span the width, one filled solid white and the rest dim.
behaviour: Slides slide in from the side every few seconds while the active progress segment fills from left to right; clicking a segment jumps to that tip and the caption swaps.
demo_content: Photos of a snowy house, mountains and a red building, captioned with product tips about components and batch scripts.
search_phrases: tips carousel for a landing page
slideshow with text under each image
image gallery that advances on its own
use_when: You want to surface several product tips or announcements as photos that advance on their own.
avoid_when: It autoplays and needs remote images; captions can be missed since slides move on a timer.
customise: tips takes objects with text, image and optional url; autoplay interval, aspect ratio, navigation, indicators and text position are props.
weight_why: Five large remote photos and an autoplay timer; one slide animates at a time.

a11y.note: Captions change on a timer without a live region, so screen readers may not hear the new tip.

issues: Tips autoplay with no pause control, so captions can change before they are read.
The progress segments are hairline-thin, making their click targets hard to hit.
Reduced motion only shortens the slide transition; autoplay still advances the tips.
polish_why: Clean editorial frame and a neat progress row; thin segments and forced autoplay limit it.
